correctness.rationale: Exact pivotal-coalition count yields Banzhaf beta_i=t_i/16 and Shapley–Shubik phi_i=t_i/30. The ten independent complementary choices account for every one of 1024 majority extensions. The exact standard-library program enumerates these 1024 and derives exactly 12 power-fair rules, nearest-fair histogram (12,120,360,380,140,12), tie-dictator extremals, and crown adjacency. Every computation is bounded, deterministic, and replayed. No infinite case is inferred.

value.rationale: For a natural finite family of six-voter strictly-majoritarian neutral rules, the theorem answers the decision-design question of how many balanced changes to tied outcomes are required to restore two canonical equal-power notions. The radius five is attained exactly by 12 identifiable decision rules, and the exact histogram plus crown reconfiguration graph specifies the whole finite feasibility landscape. The known Icos instance or its uniqueness alone does not give these actionable exact repair statistics. Finite scope is explicit.
